name: Panasonic KX-TGB610 DECT
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk. Photo to be confirmed.
description: The Panasonic KX-TGB610 is a compact DECT cordless phone (single handset) with a dedicated Call Block button (up to 50 numbers), an enhanced receiver twice as loud as standard, and a clear 1.4-inch display with caller ID. Shock-resistant, with a keypad lock.
